notes.title: Pre W.A.S.D. Build 0.1.4
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for playtesting so far!
[list]
[*] Assets should preform better at higher resolutions
[*] Improved Battle Tutorial
[*] Enemy Chef Selection begins on a random Chef
[*] Improved battle balance
[*] Sprites to enhance certain minigames
[*] Raw Egg's Throw Guard improvement
[*] Combat Log now disabled by default and can be toggled by presing Tab
[*] A slew of bug fixes
[/list]
